purpose: Candidate-set table for constrained diagnosis-code decoding on specialty referral forms. Maps a drug to the diagnosis families it can plausibly be prescribed for, in both ICD-10-CM and ICD-9-CM, because legacy forms in circulation still carry ICD-9 codes.
warning: STARTER SET. Families are given as prefixes; leaf codes must be validated against the current code set before use in adjudication. This table exists to shrink the decoder's candidate space, not to establish coverage.

adalimumab.note: Includes biosimilars; tablet form exists but referral forms are for the injectable.

control_examples.description: Polyarteritis nodosa and allied conditions, unspecified
control_examples.note: Appears on a current referral form; coding system retired in the US in 2015, and not a treated indication. Two independent defects.

validation_rules.icd10_syntax: starts with a letter; no letters I or O anywhere; decimal after the 3rd character; 3-7 characters total
validation_rules.icd9_syntax: 3 digits, optional decimal, optional 4th/5th digit; or V/E prefix form
validation_rules.note: ICD-10-CM carries no check digit, so syntax plus code-set existence plus the drug-indication candidate set is the full deterministic validation available.
